name: Sci-Fi Guns and Future Tech Pack
description: Standalone H-release compatible future-technology pack for CDDA. Adds plasma, electrical, magnetic, arc, coil and photon/laser guns with custom ammo and magazines, plus mod-owned components, tools, passive armour, melee equipment, furniture, vehicle parts, a mobile research quad, recipes, loot groups, terrain, and construction. Uses direct H item types GUN/AMMO/MAGAZINE and JSON-defined equipment with no UPS dependency. Includes 32x32 gun, ammo, and magazine tiles. Item JSON is split into guns, ammo, magazines, components, and equipment folders. The tilesheets are stored in a tileset folder and referenced from mod_tileset.json. Adds strict real item group hooks; guns, ammo, magazines, and future-tech equipment remain separated.
